leakage_audit.ordinary_boundary: Only explicit observed state43 (or its declared51D projection) and issued action5/8. cube/task/episode IDs, true labels, episode outcomes and future diagnostics are not model inputs.
leakage_audit.policy_lift: Exact historical collector supplies actor_mass_guess_kg=.04 times gravity, never sampled true_mass, to policy_obs. Policy-only guessed weight is not saved inside state43.
leakage_audit.scripted_motion: Mass and friction only instantiate simulator physics and checking labels. Lift speed/height, slide speed/direction and shove force draw from [seed,cube,1,task,episode] motion RNG; physics uses [seed,cube,0].
leakage_audit.grip_controls: Random cap depends on independent [seed,cube,917,task,episode//5] RNG and fixed step45; pilot caps form the same fullfactorial sweep for every mass/friction condition. No mg/mu-derived cap.
leakage_audit.force_controls: J-transpose wrench uses commanded horizontal force, fixed vertical/orientation targets, observed robot state and robot passive compensation; no true cube mass/friction is read in control.
leakage_audit.candidate_caches: True physics resets the simulator. Candidate magnitudes use a fixed1–4N grid. Model planner chooses using measured ready state and learned beliefs, not labels. Oracle-complement cache enumerates remaining candidates independently of physics labels.
privileged_derived_artifacts: linear_decoder is fitted with true training physics labels; not an ordinary observation.
oracle_force_n/oracle_candidate_index in oracle CSVs use actual future counterfactual simulator outcomes; do not use as blind-input features or deployable control rules.
actual_endpoint/target_error/success and episode stop/slip/acquisition summaries reveal future outcomes; not pre-action features.
Diagnostic beliefs are learned/adapted artifacts, not raw sensors; ceiling beliefs already use other same-cube shove observations.
leakage_audit.observed_responses: Mass/friction effects in measured forces, positions, velocities, gaps and contact timing are intended physical evidence, not direct label leakage.

split_cautions: IDs0..199 are train and200..229 test in all fullmain variants. They identify the same sampled physical cubes across nov13/three_task/paired arms.
Smoke IDs0/1 duplicate fulltraining cubes, including smoke testcube1.
All target/oracle/force diagnostic cache cubeIDs inherit fulltest membership; do not silently promote them into training.
Pilots have factorial physics conditions but no independent train/test cube split.
Deduplicate by canonical physicalcube, not byfile,episode,trajectoryvariant,modelseed or griparm before correlations/splitting.
